scope: Static source index for committed GX Python, in-tree examples and tests. Database DDL compiled in memory; no business execution. Runtime SQL sites include SQL construction as well as inline statements. Static caller edges list only resolved Python calls to literal SQL writers; omit dispatch registries, callbacks and other unresolved objects. The per-table state transition list includes resolved calls to store.transition, while state_fields shows schema columns and declared machine IDs. See GX_SOURCE.md for normal entry points, dynamic calls, and behavior and test interpretation. FTS shadow tables are SQLite internals.
